title.value: Diffusion Minimization and Sheaf Neural Networks for Recommender Systems

TLDR.value: Novel approach to minimise oversmothing via sheaves on graphs

abstract.value: Graph Neural Networks (GNN) are well-known for successful applications in recommender systems. Despite recent advances in GNN development, various authors report that in certain cases GNN suffer from so-called oversmoothing problems. Sheaf Neural Networks (SNN) is one of the ways to address the issue of oversmoothing. In the present work we propose a novel approach for training SNN together with user and item embeddings. In that approach parameters of the sheaf are inferred via minimization of the classical BPR loss and sheaf diffusion on graphs subjected to orthogonality and consistency constraints. Performance of the novel technique is evaluated on synthetic test cases and standard benchmarks for recommendations.

primary_area.value: learning on graphs and other geometries & topologies
